subject: Senior Systems Engineer — signing window & revised offer materials
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate Alex Moreno — competing offer + requested sign window

Hi team,

Quick context: Alex Moreno (finalist for Senior Systems Engineer, hiring for Infra Reliability) got a written offer from Nimbus AI last night. Their deadline is Tue 10/06 EOD PST. Alex told me they prefer Redwood but asked whether we can: (a) increase RSU package by ~10% or (b) provide a one-time sign-on; and (b) extend the signing window to 10/08 if needed.

Current approved offer (L5):
- Base: $195,000
- Target cash + bonus: 15%
- Equity: 0.22% over 4y (with standard cliff)
- Signing window: 7 days (standard)

Ask: Candidate asked for a small uplift. My recommendation is to avoid changing base (budget constraints) but either:
- approve a $15,000 one-time sign-on + +10% RSU (prorated), OR
- approve 7% base uplift (this requires comp-band exception + finance ok).

I attached the draft offer_letter_v2.pdf and a short comp-band-exception-request.pdf summarizing the request. If we want to keep base unchanged, I can offer a larger sign-on + equity tweak which should be within the hiring budget.

Time is tight — Alex expects an answer by 10/06 EOD PST. If we can greenlight an exception or sign-on today, I can send a revised offer and DocuSign link immediately.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
(415) 555-0184
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate Alex Moreno — competing offer + requested sign window

Priya — thanks for the note and the clear options. My read: Alex is a strong match; we should avoid setting a precedent by raising base for negotiation unless absolutely necessary. Approve the $15k one-time sign-on + a 7% RSU uplift (prorated) if that stays within the hiring budget.

Can Marcus approve the comp-band exception for the RSU increase? If Marcus signs off, please proceed with DocuSign and ask for signature by 10/06 17:00 PST. If candidate pushes for 10/08, we can consider a 48-hour extension only if Nimbus doesn't already have a signed packet.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Engineering Manager, Infra Reliability
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate Alex Moreno — competing offer + requested sign window

Laura/Priya — I approve the following, conditional on HR/Finance confirmation by EOD:
- One-time sign-on: $15,000 (gross)
- Equity uplift: +7% (rounded) to the RSU grant
- Do NOT increase base salary — keep comp-band intact.

If HR flags any issues with the band exception, revert to the sign-on only. Priya, please prepare DocuSign and include the comp-band-exception memo as an internal attachment (for audit). Extend signing window to 72 hours (3 days) from the time the offer is sent if the candidate requests it — no more than that.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Engineering
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@gmail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood Inference — revised offer materials (Senior Systems Engineer)

Alex — great speaking with you this morning. Thank you again for your transparency about the Nimbus offer — we value your timeline. Attached is an updated offer packet (offer_letter_v2.pdf) reflecting:
- One-time sign-on: $15,000 (paid at first payroll)
- Equity increase: ~7% uplift to the originally discussed grant (final grant in DocuSign)
- Base salary remains $195,000

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/s/Redwood-AXM-Offer-2026
Please review and, if comfortable, sign by Tue 10/06 17:00 PST. If you need a short extension to Thu 10/08 17:00 PST, let me know and I will request it — we may only be able to extend to 72 hours after sending by policy.

We’re excited about the prospect of you joining Redwood. Quick answers to your earlier questions: promotion cycle cadence is annual; early promotion consideration possible after 12 months subject to performance and business needs.

Attachments: offer_letter_v2.pdf (summary), comp-band-exception-request.pdf (internal)

Best,
Priya
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@gmail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T19:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — revised offer materials (Senior Systems Engineer)

Hi Priya — thank you and the team for the quick revision, I appreciate it. Redwood is my top choice. A couple points before I sign:
1) The RSU uplift is helpful, but Nimbus has offered a heavier equity package (they're offering 0.30% over 4y). Would Redwood consider an additional ~0.05% to close the gap?
2) Can we confirm a 10/08 deadline? I have a final call with Nimbus on 10/06 and they may ask for a verbal commitment.
3) Curious whether the sign-on is discretionary or would be subject to clawback if I leave within 12 months.

If you can get me a final statement on (1) and (2) I can likely sign within 48 hours. I prefer Redwood but need to make sure the total comp picture aligns with my other offers.

Thanks,
Alex
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: FWD: Candidate Alex Moreno — final equity request and extension ask

Marcus/Laura — forwarding Alex's ask: +0.05% RSU and extension to 10/08. Marcus previously approved +7% RSU uplift and $15k sign-on; can we stretch to an additional +0.05% RSU (one-time exception) and give him the 48-hour extension? HR will likely confirm clawback language for the sign-on (standard 12-month prorated clawback). Please reply ASAP so I can communicate to Alex.

Thanks,
Priya
